This is a heavily modified version of an original M3A1 grease gun that brings it slightly into the 21st century. Featuring a camo paint job and two fancy attachments, it gives the user a slight advantage to the original.
 %c[ui_gray_2]ATTACHMENTS:
 %c[d_purple] - %c[ui_gray_2] Scopes for Picatinny rail
 %c[d_purple] - %c[ui_gray_2] Comes with Trijicon RX30 sight
 %c[d_purple] - %c[ui_gray_2] Permanent homemade suppressor
